name: Historic Centre (Old Town) of Tallinn
description: Tallinn's Old Town, on the Baltic coast of Estonia, is a walled medieval quarter that grew around a 13th-century castle built by the Teutonic Order. Its cobbled lanes still follow the original medieval street plan, lined with merchants' houses and grand churches that show the wealth of the Hanseatic trading era. Much of it dates from the 13th to 16th centuries, and it survived fires and wartime bombing.
